definitions.explanation: Colloquial form of いろいろな. Used to describe many different kinds.

examples.japanese: {色|いろ}んな{経験|けいけん}をした。
{色|いろ}んな{国|くに}に{行|い}った。

notes:
{色|いろ}んな is a colloquial contraction of いろいろな (various).

FORMALITY:
- いろいろな: standard/formal
- {色|いろ}んな: casual/colloquial

COMMON USAGE:
- {色|いろ}んな{人|ひと} (various people)
- {色|いろ}んな{場所|ばしょ} (various places)
- {色|いろ}んな{経験|けいけん} (various experiences)

Note: Like いろいろな, this is a pre-noun modifier and does not take だ/です. Cannot be used predicatively.
